subject: CS241
filterSummary: Successfully selected 5 English and 5 Arabic videos. The English selections are from highly-regarded channels with strong view counts, often using excellent pedagogical techniques like analogies and clear structure. The Arabic selections are also strong, with high view counts demonstrating their popularity and effectiveness, though for some topics, the pool of eligible candidates was smaller. All selected videos are highly relevant to their respective topics.

coverage.note: Most candidates were either in English or failed duration/view gates.
Only one candidate passed the 3000 view count gate.

videos.title: L-4.6: What is Hazard in Pipelining | various types of Hazards | computer Architecture
videos.filter_reason: A comprehensive and highly-viewed video that explicitly covers all types of pipeline hazards, making it a perfect resource.

videos.title: CO23 - ISA - Expanding opcodes
videos.filter_reason: This video's title is a perfect match for the topic and it has a strong view count, indicating its effectiveness as an educational resource.

videos.title: Addressing Modes in Computer Organization & Architecture: Types and Examples | COA
videos.filter_reason: Excellent, comprehensive video with timestamps for each addressing mode, making it easy for students to navigate to specific concepts.

videos.title: L-1.17: Register Stack Organisation | Zero Address Instructions | COA
videos.filter_reason: This highly-viewed video perfectly covers both stack organization and zero-address instructions, directly addressing the core student difficulty.

videos.title: Endianness Explained With an Egg - Computerphile
videos.filter_reason: From the reputable Computerphile channel, this video uses a memorable analogy ('explained with an egg') to clarify a difficult visualization topic.

videos.title: EmbeddedNotes  - 7 -  Pipeline  - 2 - Hazards (Arabic)
videos.filter_reason: This is a clear, well-structured explanation of pipeline hazards with a high view count and a link to presentation slides.

videos.title: COA |Chapter 10 Instruction sets | Machine instruction / Opcode / Number of addresses  بالعربي
videos.filter_reason: This video clearly explains the relationship between opcodes and the number of addresses, which is the foundation of the expanding opcodes technique.

videos.title: Addressing modes 8086  شرح بالعربي
videos.filter_reason: An exceptionally popular and concise video that uses concrete 8086 examples to explain the different addressing modes clearly.

videos.title: 7- شرح الـ Postfix & Prefix Evaluation using Stack

videos.title: Big and Little Endian Formats in Computer Organization
videos.filter_reason: A concise and direct explanation of the topic that was the only eligible candidate to meet all selection criteria.
